The '''ICM-092792''',<ref name="SW EOSAOV (SE)" /> also known simply as an '''Imperial construction module''',<ref name="DB Module" /> '''construction sphere''',<ref name="Honorable Trivia">{{SW|url=the-honorable-ones-trivia-gallery|text="The Honorable Ones" Trivia Gallery}}</ref> '''Imperial reclamation plant''',<ref name="HC 47">{{HelmetCollectionCite|47|Databank A-Z}}, </ref> '''orbital command habitat''',<ref name="Catalyst: A Rogue One Novel">''[[Catalyst: A Rogue One Novel]]''</ref> or '''in-orbit construction module'''<ref name="Millennium Falcon 87">{{FalconCite|87|Secrets of Spaceflight}}</ref> was a model of large-scale [[space station]] manufactured by [[Huppla Pasa Tisc Shipwrights Collective]]<ref name="SW EOSAOV (SE)" /> and used by the [[Galactic Empire]] during building projects. Such modules were equipped with several crane arms<ref name="Honorable Concept">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/the-honorable-ones-concept-art-gallery|text="The Honorable Ones" Concept Art Gallery}}</ref> and contained all data, materials, and plans related to the development of a given project.<ref name="DB Module" /> The [[Imperial Complex (Lothal)|Command Center]] built by the Empire in the [[Capital City|capital]] of the [[planet]] [[Lothal]] was of the same design as those construction modules,<ref name="Honorable Trivia" /> as was [[Yarma]]'s [[Reklam Station]].<ref name="Steps">''[[Star Wars Rebels: Steps Into Shadow]]''</ref>

[[File:ConstructDeathStar-CM.png|thumb|left|220px|Several constructions modules were used during construction of the Death Star.]]
Several construction modules were used to support the construction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] in the [[orbit]] of the planet [[Geonosis]].<ref name="Rebels Recon">{{RebelsRecon|9E3T5LhlV_c|#2.16: Inside "The Honorable Ones" | Star Wars Rebels|sw_url=video/rebels-recon-inside-the-honorable-ones}}</ref> Eventually, the Death Star was moved to [[Scarif]].<ref name="Tarkin">[[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']]</ref> In the third [[Standard year|year]] before the [[Battle of Yavin]]<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know, Updated and Expanded]]'' states that [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] was 16 [[Standard year|years]] old during her [[Mission on Lothal|mission]] on [[Lothal]]. Since ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' establishes that Organa was [[Reproduction|born]] in [[19 BBY]], the mission must take place in [[3 BBY]]. ''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]'' dates the [[Attack on Phoenix Squadron (3 BBY)|attack]] on [[Phoenix Squadron]] to three [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin]], or [[3 BBY]] according to ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''{{'}} [[Galactic standard calendar|dating system]]. As this ambush takes place between these two events, it must also take place in 3 BBY.</ref> those spheres orbiting Geonosis were discovered by the rebellion, a network of cells that sought to overthrow the Empire. Consequently, the rebel [[Spectres|crew]] of the ''[[Ghost]]'' was dispatched there to retrieve the sphere's [[databank]]s, which could provide information on whatever the Empire was building at Geonosis. That module, however, had been inactive for some time, and the rebels had fallen into an Imperial trap; as soon as they entered the base, the freedom fighters were [[Ambush on an Imperial construction module|ambushed]] by [[Agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus|Kallus]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] and several [[squad]]s of [[stormtrooper]]s.<ref name="The Honorable Ones">{{Rebels|The Honorable Ones}}</ref>

[[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] employed construction modules above Lothal along with his [[Seventh Fleet (Galactic Empire)|7th Fleet]], in order to oversee his [[mining]] operation there. [[Captain]] [[Hera Syndulla]] of the Spectres was able to break through the [[blockade]] of Lothal by launching into [[hyperspace]] through the [[hangar]] of a construction module, destroying docked [[starship]]s and damaging the station.<ref name="Kindred" />
